title: Hanoi in a day
summary: The lake in the morning, pho in the Hoan Kiem lanes, the citadel before lunch, bun cha around Cua Dong, and the water puppets in the evening.

stops.name: Pho
stops.note: Have a morning bowl in the Hoan Kiem lanes.

stops.name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
stops.note: Visit the citadel grounds before lunch.

stops.name: Bun cha
stops.note: Eat bun cha around Cua Dong.

stops.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
stops.note: See the water puppets on the east side of the lake.

seoDescription: A one-day Hanoi plan: Hoan Kiem, pho, the citadel, bun cha at lunch, and the water puppets.
